title: archive_settings_loading bool beside archive_chat_list_settings Option
trigger: Open archive settings; fetch fails
effect: Loading is a bool kept in step with the cached Option and cleared in apply and error arms
fix: Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings>.

title: ClosingSet: close_held_until Option in the driver + restart bool + unconfirmed set; close_all_within/Drop block the calling thread
trigger: Quit or drop a ClosingSet while clients are closing
effect: close sent either at once or after a hold timer that only drain_bridged releases; a client unconfirmed stays blocked for the process; Drop sleeps up to 1.5 s on whichever thread drops the set
fix: enum Closing { Holding{until}, Sent, Closed, Lost } per client; keep the blocking wait to the quit path only.

title: Draft save pipeline: pending_draft Option + draft_clock + draft_save_token + session dirty flag
trigger: Type in two slots (main and a chat window)
effect: One save waits at a time; settle/flush/cancel paths each reset clock and pending by hand (seven sites)
fix: enum DraftSave { Idle, Waiting{slot, started, token, content}, Sending(RequestId) }.

title: Contacts list: contacts Option + contacts_error bool + in-flight purpose
trigger: Open Contacts, add/delete a contact (list set to None) while offline
effect: refetch_invalidated_contacts re-derives loading from three places; a send failure sets contacts_error by hand
fix: Fetch<Vec<UserId>>.

title: BatchState is open + three dirty bools + a waiting-file set kept in step by hand
trigger: Each envelope in a poll batch sets dirty flags; end_batch takes them and runs the passes.
effect: No bug today; end_batch takes the flag before the pass runs, so a send error in run_shown_media loses that pass until another update dirties it (S4).
fix: One enum Batch{Closed, Open{dirty: PassSet}} and take a pass only after it succeeded.

title: Deep-link flow keeps DeepLinkState plus a separate origin bool, original string and generation counter
trigger: request_deep_link_info / continue_deep_link / confirm_deep_link_invite each set several fields.
effect: No bug found; answers are matched by generation. deep_link_from_agent and deep_link_original live outside the enum and are overwritten on every start.
fix: Carry origin and original link inside the DeepLinkState variants.

title: Disk-low handling uses disk_holds_auto_downloads, disk_room, disk_paused, disk_resume_searched and avatar_rescan flags
trigger: Disk goes low then healthy.
effect: disk_holds_auto_downloads is derived from disk state elsewhere (connect/media.rs) and must match disk_room; disk_resume_searched and avatar_rescan are 'once' markers.
fix: One DiskPressure enum (Healthy, Low{room, paused}) and a ResumeSearch enum.

title: disk_resume_searched bool + disk_search_keys + SearchDiskPausedDownloads request + disk_resume_due form one search stage
trigger: Healthy disk with saved pauses starts the once-per-session search.
effect: No bug today (flag reset on send failure, but an error answer leaves it true by design).
fix: enum DiskSearch{Idle, Asked{keys}, Done}.

title: Download tracking is split across media.downloads, download_extras, open_chat_media_downloads, avatar_downloads_due, avatar_claims and the request registry
trigger: Start, pause, cancel and retry a download while the chat changes.
effect: should_download, unstick_download, abort_download and upsert_file each consult or clear a different subset (requested, paused, cancelling, stalled, user, listed), so a request that is requested in one and absent in another can be sent twice or never.
fix: One per-file DownloadStage enum (Idle, Requested(origin, RequestId), Paused, Cancelling, Stalled, Done) owned by the download map, with avatar and chat-media demands as derived reads.

title: Earn withdrawal / setup / join / revoke each hold stage flags beside Options
trigger: Collect/Withdraw, save program, join program, revoke link.
effect: Withdraw is matched by request id (waits_for) so no bug found; Password{sending:bool}, SetupPage.saving/confirm, EarnState.setup_closed, JoinBox.joining, Revoke.sending are stage bools.
fix: Make joining/sending part of the step enum (Idle/Sending{request}).

title: Recipients load is recipients Option + recipients_loading counter + pending_join + join_box
trigger: open_bot_affiliate_join / open_affiliate_program ask two requests and park the join box until both answered.
effect: If the second send fails after the first went out, recipients_loading is reset to 0 while the first answer later fills recipients with a partial list (user + channels, no bots) that is then cached for the session (S4).
fix: enum Recipients{Idle, Loading{chats,bots}, Ready(Vec)} and a join box that carries its own wait.

title: Affiliate join/revoke/setup use bools and a counter as stages
trigger: Join an affiliate program, choose recipient, end a program
effect: JoinBox.joining, Revoke.sending, earn.recipients_loading (u8 counter, 2 means two lists out) with earn.pending_join (a parked box), earn.setup_closed (one-shot flag the UI drains) are set and cleared across earn.rs:181,257,407,514-523 and connect/earn.rs
fix: enum Join{Idle,Resolving{request},Choosing,Joining{request}} and Recipients{Idle,Loading{chats,bots},Ready(list)}.

title: WithdrawStep::Password carries a `sending` bool and an error Option inside the variant
trigger: Submit the withdrawal password.
effect: Works today (the request id on Withdraw matches answers), but Sending is a flag inside a stage.
fix: Split into WithdrawStep::Password { error } and WithdrawStep::SendingPassword, so sending and an error cannot coexist.

title: Each revenue box is a field (learn bool, ton_tx, star_tx, ask_boost) set by hand next to a separate open_box(DialogKind) call
trigger: Open the Learn more box (revenue.rs:104-113); the demo sets earn.learn without open_box (demo.rs:96).
effect: No user bug found; the box flag and its window record are two writes kept in step at every opener.
fix: One Option<EarnBox> enum (Learn { diamonds }, TonTx, StarTx, AskBoost) opened by one helper that also records the asking window.

title: The setup sliders are two Options created by a per-frame upkeep and reset by hand in open_earn, separate from the session's SetupPage
trigger: Open an affiliate setup page: open_earn clears earn.setup and both sliders, ensure_setup_sliders builds them when setup arrives; ending at drop_earn_layer leaves them Some.
effect: No bug today; commission, duration and setup.params must stay in step, and any path that replaces earn.setup without open_earn (a back-stack pop to Setup) would show the other bot's sliders.
fix: Keep the sliders inside one SetupUi value keyed by bot_user_id and rebuilt when the bot id differs.

title: link_shown mirrors link_box.is_some() and is kept in step by the main window's frame upkeep
trigger: Open a referral link box; earn_frame_upkeep sets link_shown on the next frame after the first render and clears it when the box closes.
effect: The first render of the link box sees None and draws the settled icon, and nothing notifies after the upkeep sets it, so the one-time play starts late or on the next input. Chat windows never run the upkeep.
fix: Store the open time in LinkBox when the answer lands, or derive the animation from the dialog's open event.

title: Chosen sticker category is a bare index into the session's category list
trigger: Choose a category in the sticker tab; later the list is reloaded (sticker_categories_asked reset, premium state change) in another order.
effect: pickers.media_panel.category is an index, so after a reload it can name another category; wanted_sticker_search then searches that one.
fix: Store the EmojiCategorySource (the key) instead of the index.

title: Emoji pack browser stage is open + tab + trending_offset + mutating_set + mutation_failed + search_query
trigger: Open the browser, switch tabs, install/remove a pack.
effect: No bug found; stale tab answers are dropped by take_purpose.
fix: enum EmojiBrowser{Closed, Open{tab, mutation: Idle|Changing|Failed}}.

title: Add-folder-by-link dialog is folder_invite_link + info + error + done + request
trigger: Open an addlist link: check_folder_invite_link resets four fields and sets request.
effect: If the send fails, link is Some with info/error None and no request: dialog shows no result and no error (S3 plausible).
fix: enum FolderInvite{Idle, Checking{link,request}, Ready{..}, Failed{..}, Adding{..}, Done}.

title: Saved sublists: topics_requested/topics_exhausted bools, SavedTagSearch.request Option, history.loaded_complete
trigger: Open Saved Messages, scroll sublists, filter by tag.
effect: No bug found; topics_requested is reset on error and the tag request is matched by id.
fix: Fetch<Page> per list.

title: Which conversation is shown is open_topic, threads.thread, threads.direct.open and threads.saved.sublist kept mutually exclusive by hand
trigger: Open a forum topic, open a comment thread inside it, switch chats; or select a direct-messages conversation then a topic.
effect: open_topic_id and open_draft_topic resolve the clash by a fixed priority order (thread, direct, topic, saved) and select_topic/deselect_topic/select_chat/leave_open_chat each clear a different subset (close_topic_thread_unless, saved.close_views), so a missed clear shows the wrong conversation's drafts and sends.
fix: One OpenConversation enum on the view (Chat, Topic(i32), Thread(..), Direct(i64), Saved(..)) replaced whole when the chat or sub-view changes; open_topic_id becomes a match.

title: Saved Messages sublist load is topics_requested + retry_when_online + topics_exhausted
trigger: LoadSavedMessagesTopics error sets topics_requested = false and retry_when_online = true; 404 sets topics_exhausted; common/apply.rs:217 and session_chatlist.rs:198 clear retry_when_online elsewhere.
effect: Three bools changed from four places; a missed reset leaves the pump asking or never asking.
fix: enum SavedTopicsLoad { Idle, Loading, Retry, Exhausted }.

title: SavedTagSearch: loaded + request + history.loaded_complete
fix: Page stage enum Idle | Asking(RequestId) | Done | Failed.

title: SavedMessagesState: topics_requested, topics_exhausted, retry_when_online, tags_loaded are a hand-kept fetch stage
fix: Fetch-like enum for topics and one for tags.

title: GIF panel stage is open + search_mode + search_loading + search_failed + loading + loaded + failed + stale
trigger: Open GIF panel, search, switch back to saved, bot username changes (core/mod.rs gif_bot_changed).
effect: No bug found; errors reset search_loading. The ingest loop re-calls maybe_search_gifs every envelope while search_loading is true.
fix: enum GifPanel{Saved(Fetch), Search{query, Fetch, next}}.

title: Gift management is gift_mutating + gifts_error + note, collections_loading/stale, export_unlocked and TransferStage::Password{sending}
trigger: Pin, upgrade, transfer, delete, export-to-Fragment.
effect: No bug found beyond the entry above; the reducer unlocks on the answer and settle_lost_request clears it.
fix: enum GiftMutation{Idle, InFlight{request, purpose}, Failed} and put export_unlocked into the transfer stage.

title: hub.gift_mutating bool gates every owner action button
trigger: Set by the driver before a pin/upgrade/transfer/resale/delete request and cleared by the reducer.
effect: A bare bool with no request id (see the reopen bug).
fix: enum GiftMutation { Idle, Running{request, purpose} }.

title: Gift market uses ResaleSearch loading/loaded/error, candidates_loading, auction_loading/ready/request, bidding, buy.sending, craft.crafting
trigger: Resale browsing, auctions, bidding, crafting.
effect: Answers are matched by stored request ids; no bug found beyond the replace case above.
fix: Fetch<Page> per list and a Purchase enum.

title: GiftValueLookup is request + loading + info + error + open
trigger: Tap the Value row's learn more.
effect: No bug found; answers match lookup.request and another gift replaces the lookup.
fix: enum GiftValue{Loading{request}, Ready{info, open}, Failed}.

title: GiftValueLookup stage is loading + open + error + info + request
trigger: Click 'learn more' on a unique gift, fail, retry, close, reopen, switch gift.
effect: land/fail guard on loading && id==request, but 'open' is set only on land and cleared by close; the lookup survives closing so its stage is spread over five fields.
fix: enum GiftValueLookupStage { Idle, Loading(RequestId), Failed(String), Ready{info, open: bool} } or Fetch<GiftValueInfo> plus a separate box-open flag in the dialog state.

title: GiftValueLookup loading/error/info/open
trigger: The lookup is loading, ready (info+open), failed (error) or closed (info, open=false).
effect: Four fields, request id and name filter.
fix: Fetch<GiftValueInfo> plus an open flag owned by the dialog.

title: AwardMembers has loading bool beside generation, offset and query
trigger: Search or scroll the 'Choose members' list.
effect: No bug found; answers are generation-matched.
fix: Fetch<Page> with generation inside.

title: AwardMembers stage is loading + done + error + generation
trigger: Open Choose members, type a search, scroll.
effect: loading, done and error can be set together; generation matches answers (good) but the stage is still flags.
fix: enum MembersStage { Loading, Ready, Failed(String), Done } with the generation beside it.

title: Password field focus is a caller-owned bool mirror (focused) updated every frame by keep_password_field
trigger: gift_transfer_frame_upkeep and the grams withdraw upkeep each own a *_password_focused bool; it is set when idle first becomes true and cleared when not idle
effect: None today; focus is re-taken only on the idle edge, so a box that stays idle but loses focus is not refocused
fix: Move focus-on-entry into the stage transition (focus when the stage becomes the idle Password variant) and drop the bool

title: AwardMembers loading/error/user_ids beside generation and asked-guard
trigger: The members page shows error, loading row, empty text or list from list.error, list.loading and shown.
effect: Both error and loading can be set; paging guarded by a second Asked struct in PaymentsUi.
fix: Fetch<Page> with the paging position inside.

title: Giveaway options keep premium_loading/stars_loading with premium_error/stars_error pairs
trigger: Open the giveaway form for a channel.
effect: Both loading+error pairs can be set; an answer for an earlier boosted chat is not keyed (S3 plausible if the form is reopened for another channel).
fix: Fetch<Options> keyed by boosted chat.

title: Giveaway lookup and options keep loading bools beside error fields
trigger: Open About this giveaway; open the new-giveaway form
effect: GiveawayInfoLookup.loading/error/info, GiveawayOptions.premium_loading/stars_loading with premium_error/stars_error (both can be set); option answers are matched only by purpose (apply.rs 136,150) so a stale reply from a reopened form lands
fix: Fetch<T> per list with the request id; GiveawayLaunch is already the right shape.

title: GiveawayOptions premium_loading/stars_loading/premium_error/stars_error beside the lists
trigger: Two requests fill two lists; the body derives loading from loading() && both empty.
effect: Each list is a loading bool, an error Option and a Vec.
fix: Two Fetch<Vec<Option>> values.

title: GiveawayInfoLookup has loading, error and info Option kept in step
trigger: getGiveawayInfo: loading=true, then info Some or error Some.
effect: Three fields for four stages; matched to its request by take_answer.
fix: Fetch<GiveawayInfoData>.

title: My Grams page is open + loading + loaded + error + request + probed + peers_dirty
trigger: Open My Grams, switch All/Incoming/Outgoing.
effect: No bug found; restart replaces the request id.
fix: Fetch<TxPage> per filter.

title: Share-link generation is generating: bool beside two Option links, hand-reset on a send failure
trigger: Press Share Invite Link; the second (speaker) send fails after the listener request went out
effect: generating is forced false while the listener request is still in flight; a second press can send the listener request twice (harmless)
fix: Each link as Fetch<String>; generating is derived.

title: A conference join is pending_conference + conference_crypto(PENDING key) + group_offers[PENDING] + a native instance kept in step by hand
trigger: Join/invite/upgrade a conference, fail or cancel at each step (conference.rs:188-203, :280-283, offers.rs:316-319)
effect: No bug proven; every exit must clear all four and tests only cover some
fix: One ConferenceJoin enum owned by the driver with a single teardown.
